toolchain:
Apple Swift version 6.3.3 (swiftlang-6.3.3.1.3 clang-2100.1.1.101)

limits: Managed native-idle/finalizing/reconciliation fence is required; directory lock alone does not exclude creator startup.
Actual service retry/reopen RED-to-GREEN and atomic selector integration remain with the atomic owner.
No deterministic in-flight directory replacement or EIO fault injection; existing inode checks and operational outer refusal remain.
First candidate alias failure complete request/reply/log retained, but its intermediate runner and source were not separately pinned.
No hardware/device enumeration, UI/playback, model construction/preparation/download/install/inference, CLI review retry, installed switching or physical acceptance.
redSourceProvenance: Production files and remaining native inputs are base commit e8eb83bb; red-test.swift.txt/red-main.swift.txt reconstruct the exact initial test-only changes from the authored patches before RED. They were not separately copied at RED build time; RED executable is frozen and pinned.
